notifications.name: Brow Lamination
notifications.danger: The product has an excessive concentration of thioglycolic acid (measured value: 3.1% by weight), that can irritate the skin, as well as BMHCA, which is prohibited in n cosmetic products. BMHCA may harm the reproductive system, may harm the health of the unborn child and may cause skin sensitisation. The product does not comply with the Cosmetic Products Regulation.
notifications.measures: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): OtherCategory of measure(s): Withdrawal of the product from the marketDate of entry into force: 29/11/2024
notifications.description: Brow lamination kit, including brow affix, style solution, neutraliser, treatment oil, plastic film, a spoolie, and clear mini combs. The product is sold online on several websites. The batch numbers mentioned are those which were tested, however all batches are concerned by the measure.

notifications.name: Baby Powder 100% talc free
notifications.danger: The product is microbiologically contaminated with aerobic mesophilic bacteria (measured value up to 440 CFU/g). If used on damaged skin, or if it comes into contact with the eyes, the product may cause infection or irritation. The product does not comply with the Cosmetic Products Regulation nor with the European standard EN 17516.

notifications.name: FRITEUSE COMPACTE
notifications.danger: A manufacturing error allows the temperature-increase limits of the power cable and the internal earth wire to be exceeded, posing a risk of fire. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Low Voltage Directive.

notifications.description: Electric deep-fat fryer. All batches are affected.

notifications.danger: The thigh straps of the harness are not resistant enough as they break under a load of 12.63 kN. In the event of a user's fall, the harness breaking creates a risk of injuries. The product does not comply with the Personal Protective Equipment Regulation nor with the European standard EN 361.
notifications.measures: Type of economic operator to whom the measure(s) were ordered: OtherCategory of measure(s): Ban on the marketing of the product and any accompanying measuresDate of entry into force: 09/11/2023
notifications.description: Safety harness with a belt and thigh straps. Stock keeping unit number: STK0179005885. Product sold online, in particular via eBay.

notifications.name: Surveillance, 4-Channel CCTV Surveillance Kit
notifications.danger: The power supply cable is composed of a Class II plug (without a protective earth conductor) and a Class I connector. If the power supply cable is used with a Class I electric appliance, there is no continuation of the protective earth conductor. In the event of a fault, the fault current would not be able to flow via the protective earth conductor, leading to the risk of an electric shock. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Low Voltage Directive nor with the European standard EN 60335-1.

notifications.description: 4-channel CCTV surveillance kit, four cameras monitor that send data to a computer, laptop, tablet or smartphone. Meant for outdoor use. Power supply cable enclosed with the product. Power Cable P.V.C. 3G 0.5mm. Product sold online, in particular via Amazon (ASIN: B0BSFPQV4K).

notifications.danger: The internal metal elements of the product have an excessive concentration of lead (measured value up to 0.7% by weight). Lead poses a risk to the environment. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Directive on the restriction of the use of certain hazardous substances in electrical and electronic equipment (RoHS 2 Directive).
notifications.measures: Type of economic operator to whom the measure(s) were ordered: ImporterCategory of measure(s): Withdrawal of the product from the marketDate of entry into force: 08/01/2025Type of economic operator to whom the measure(s) were ordered: ImporterCategory of measure(s): Warning consumers of the risksDate of entry into force: 08/01/2025
notifications.description: Sex toy: vibrator, made of soft plastic, powered by a built-in battery charged via a magnetic port and the included USB cable.

notifications.danger: The PVC hose has an excessive concentration of short chain chlorinated paraffins (SCCPs) and dibutyl phthalate (DBP) (measured values: 17 % and 6.4% by weight, respectively). SCCPs persist in the environment, are toxic to aquatic organisms at low concentrations and bio-accumulate in wildlife and humans, posing a risk to human health and the environment. Prolonged exposure to them through the skin may cause cancer. Moreover, DBP may harm the health by causing possible damage to the reproductive system. The product does not comply with the Persistent Organic Pollutants (POP) Regulation nor with the REACH Regulation.

notifications.danger: A technical defect in the charging station or the battery could cause a fire and burns to the user. The product does not comply with the Low Voltage Directive.

notifications.description: Fully automatic battery-operated pool robot for cleaning pools, powered by a rechargeable battery. Product sold online, in particular via steinbach-group.com.

notifications.danger: The product has an excessive concentration of cadmium (measured value up to 0.029 % by weight). Cadmium is harmful to human health because it accumulates in the body, can damage the kidneys and bones and it may cause cancer. Cadmium bio-accumulates and poses a risk to the environment. The product does not comply with the REACH Regulation.

notifications.danger: The toy contains small magnets with a high magnetic flux (measured value up to: 398 kG²mm²). If a child swallows the small magnets, they could attract one another causing intestinal blockage or perforation. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Toy Safety Directive nor with the European standard EN 71-1.

notifications.danger: The power supply has poor quality connections to its input and output, with wires soldered directly to the power circuit board with no secondary fixing. notifications.name: Grandland
notifications.danger: Due to the routing of the cable bundle of the driver and front passenger seat's cable bundle, the bundle and the seat rail's end stop can rub. This can lead to damages to the bundle by metal parts when the seat back is the rearmost position. This can provoke the seat airbag's malfunction, increasing the risk of injuries in the event of an accident. Moreover, this can cause a short-circuit, creating a risk for the vehicle to catch fire. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
notifications.measures: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): ManufacturerCategory of measure(s): Recall of the product from end usersDate of entry into force: 07/02/2025

notifications.name: Hip Seat Baby Carrier
notifications.danger: The product's retention function is not adequate. Moreover, the indications for the suitable age range are not correct. In case of a small child, which can't hold the head up, the head may drop forward while they face outward, and this can cause that the child is not able to breathe, causing the child to suffocate. The product does not comply with the General Product Safety Regulation
